R Client for the Spain Electoral Polls API
text: package covers public endpoints: GET /health GET /api/v1/elections GET /api/v1/pollsters GET /api/v1/parties GET /api/v1/polls GET /api/v1/polls/{poll_id} GET /api/v1/results GET /api/v1/timeseries GET /api/v1/polls/{poll_id}/results implemented API. Use get_poll_results() fetch /api/v1/polls/{poll_id} extract nested results.
